pass_rule: Lifecycle: all owners gone, zero GPU faults through full305s watch, completed client requests, unchanged admission/reserve/sampling gates and no teardown overrun. Traced nonzero exit or segfault recorded as expected_tracer_exit_crash, with microtest evidence; no rc0 requirement for traced server. Census validity additionally requires four complete rank traces with ITT verify markers, timestamped verify kernels and unambiguous flow coverage; graph arm requires timely resume. Startup kernels outside census scopes may remain unassigned. Diagnostic only, no speed claim.

analysis.scope: Per-rank measured device work only. Missing or ambiguous correlation remains unknown/incomplete. No assumption of400 kernels or extrapolation. Generic GEMM names need evidenced mapping; candidates are measured clusters plus dispatch-audit boundaries, not predicted savings.

local_trace_retention: Separate from deleted local scratch; coordinator copies after lifecycle and keeps local source.
trace_resume: Start paused. Supervisor thread watches server.log for Model loading took on four distinct ranks; resume exactly once, with acknowledgement before any Capturing CUDA graphs line. Continue through profiling, KV initialization, capture, readiness, 20s plateau, 30s sleep and requests; pause immediately after client completion. Failed/late resume invalidates graph attribution but does not short-circuit normal teardown or retry.
sampler_persistence: Timed sampler performs no output-mount file I/O; rows remain in memory and are enqueued to independent ext4 scratch writer. Independent live-file monitor. After lifecycle drain writer, compare exact rows, copy samples.jsonl to output, hash both, receipt, then remove scratch.
